units.source_text: 使者告道：“此次之暴风雨，京都亦疑是不祥之兆，宫中曾举办仁王法会。

en.t: The messenger reported, "This storm has also been regarded in the capital as an ominous sign, and a Ninno memorial service was held in the palace.

units.source_text: 风雨塞途，百官不得上朝，政事已告停顿。”

en.t: The wind and rain have blocked the roads, the officials cannot attend court, and government affairs have already come to a halt."

units.source_text: 此人口齿笨拙，言语支吾。

en.t: The man spoke clumsily and stumbled over his words.

units.source_text: 但源氏公子为欲详知京中状况，召他走近身边，仔细盘问。

en.t: But Prince Genji wanted to know the situation in the capital in detail, so he called the man closer and questioned him carefully.

units.source_text: 使者又说：“大雨连日不停，狂风时时发作，亦已继续多天。

en.t: The messenger went on, "The heavy rain has not stopped for days, and violent winds keep rising from time to time; this too has continued for many days.

units.source_text: 如此骇人之天气，京中从未有过。

en.t: Such terrifying weather has never been seen in the capital before.

units.source_text: 大块冰雹落下，几乎打进地底下。

en.t: Large hailstones fell, almost pounding their way into the ground.

units.source_text: 雷声惊天动地，永不停息，都是向来没有的事。”

en.t: The thunder shakes heaven and earth and never stops; all of this is unlike anything that has ever happened before."

units.source_text: 说时脸上显出恐怖畏缩之状，令人看了更增忧惧。

en.t: As he spoke, his face showed fear and cringing dread, making those who saw him feel still more anxious and afraid.
